title: Color Detective
prompt: Pick one of these, then photograph it:

prompt_options.name: Monochrome
prompt_options.text: Use one dominant color or related tones.

prompt_options.name: Color echo
prompt_options.text: Repeat the same color in different areas.

prompt_options.name: Color spotlight
prompt_options.text: Isolate one bright color in a neutral scene.

questions: Which color did you notice first?
Is another color distracting from it?
Can you change position to simplify the edges?
How does the color affect the mood?
How does the color change in sunlight and shade?
technical_reminder: If the shutter speed becomes too slow in shade, point out how the camera raises ISO, or how the photographer can choose a wider aperture.

variation.text: Photograph the same color once in bright light and once in shade.

review_prompt: Which photograph has the clearest color idea?
